Steffen Grabert, steffen.grabert@tum.de

TUM student. Python for data, ML and finance; TypeScript for web and

# AGENTS.md

Rules for AI coding agents in this repo. Humans follow them too.

Hackathon repo, EHL Grand Finale, Munich, 10 to 11 Oct 2026. Code freeze and Live Final Sunday
12:00. Working agent first, polish second.

## Rules

- Do not preserve backward compatibility. Remove obsolete paths instead of adding layers,
  fallbacks or migrations.
- Choose the simplest implementation that fully meets the current requirement. No speculative
  abstractions, configuration or indirection.
- Grow in layers on a product that already works. Never trade a working agent for unfinished
  complexity.
- Keep components modular and concerns separated.
- Read `arena_kit` (in `.venv`) before writing a helper: cost function, quote parsing, data lookup
  and runners exist. We wrap the kit, never patch it. Guide:
  https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/tree/main/starter-kit
- Never commit secrets. Keys live in `.env`. Never print, log or paste the arena key anywhere.
- All changes go through a PR against `main`, reviewed by one teammate. Branch `<firstname>/<topic>`.
  Agents may commit, push their branch and `gh pr create`; never push to `main`, force-push or merge.
- Run `uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check .` before every PR.
- No em-dashes in prose or copy. Be terse: after an action, state what changed in three lines.

## The challenge

We are the purchasing team of Hollerau Pumpenwerke. Our agent negotiates by e-mail with Tacto's
supplier bots (LLM personas with hidden economics) and closes one term sheet per case, or walks.

- **Score** per case: `(C_open - C_deal) / (C_open - C_best)`, clipped to 0..1. C is total cost
  over the horizon (price, uncovered need, payment, freight, lead time, quality, tooling, index
  clause, relationship charge), computed exactly by `arena_kit.total_cost`. No deal scores the
  alternative (0 if none). A broken must-have scores 0.
- **Live Final**: five waves of hidden cases, 8 minutes each, a wave's cases in parallel. Wave
  score = mean case score x 100; total = sum. New suppliers; up to a third mix supplier and case
  types practice never shows; some cite the Sunday 08:00 data release.

**Hard rules, breaking one can disqualify us:**
- No human in the loop during the final. The runner starts before 12:00 and is left alone.
- Agent code never calls `/v1/events`, `/v1/events/stream`, `/screen`, `/v1/screen`,
  `/leaderboard`, `/v1/leaderboard`, `/results`, `/v1/results`.
- One key per team. No attacks on the arena or other teams (prompt-injecting bots counts).
- The final runs the commit we submit at 12:00. No pushes after that.

**Hard limits:**
- 60 s per message per thread from the supplier's reply; three timeouts in a row end the thread.
- 10 messages per thread, up to 3 term sheets per message, every sheet carries every `negotiable`
  field.
- Max 3 claim checks per message, one per sentence, ID and figure in the same sentence. A wrong
  figure or unknown ID is `contradicted` and costs trust.
- 10 calls/s and 10 open sessions per key.
- **Practice quota: 200 sessions per rolling 24 h for the whole team.** Sandbox (`case:D01`,
  `case:D02`) and the local simulator are free.

## Where things are

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `docs/learnings.md` | **read first**: what we know about the arena, suppliers and data, with evidence |
| `docs/design.md` | the agent we are building: modules, data, policy, build order |
| `docs/challenge.md`, `api.md`, `submission.md` | Tacto's brief, API and cost formula, hand-in (upstream copies) |
| `buyer/policy.py`, `runner.py` | the price engine: per-thread policy and the loop that plays a case (`docs/design.md`, Implemented) |
| `buyer/economics.py`, `claims.py`, `personas.py`, `writer.py`, `llm.py` | C and term planning, claim bank, persona signals, e-mail and model paragraph |
| `buyer/cli.py` | `buyer play`, `buyer run`, `buyer pull` |
| `tests/` | end to end against `arena-sim`, no network, no model |
| `exports/` | Saturday probe sessions as CSV/JSONL; schema in `exports/README.md` |
| `analysis/explore.py` | data package exploration: profiles, persona signals, report page |
| `data/package/` | the data package (gitignored); Sunday also `data/release-sunday/` |
| `logs/sessions/<set>/` | finished sessions with trace and back office (gitignored; Saturday's committed with `-f`) |
| `logs/runs/`, `logs/practice-v*.log` | our decisions per move (anchor, terms, claims, prices) and the practice run logs |

The MCP server `arena-data` (`.mcp.json`) gives SQL, ID lookup and documents over the package.

## Commands

```sh
uv sync                                         # install (Python 3.12)
uv run arena data                               # data package into data/
uv run arena me                                 # key works? quota left?
uv run buyer play case:D01 -v                   # sandbox: free
uv run buyer play case:P01 -v                   # practice: costs 1 of the team's 200
uv run buyer run --set practice --parallel 10   # all hosted practice cases: costs 10
uv run buyer pull --set practice                # finished sessions -> logs/sessions/
uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock --data data/package   # local API, scripted supplier
uv run --with pandas python analysis/explore.py # data package -> analysis/out/
```

`--agent naive` plays the kit's baseline instead of ours.

## Working on the negotiation agent

- **Code owns numbers, the model owns words.** Every binding value (sheet, accept, walk away) is
  computed or checked in code with `total_cost` and `must_haves_ok`; every figure in an e-mail
  comes from code next to its data ID.
- **Never accept** a sheet that breaks a must-have or costs more than the alternative. Price
  unstated fields at the supplier's standard terms (`arena_kit.docs.standard_terms`).
- **Read the supplier.** What moves it is in the data (call notes, letters, news, quote remarks,
  payment history, scorecards). Trade what is cheap for us for what it values.
- **Score every lever per case.** The same term helps in one case and hurts in the next
  (coverage, payment days, start date, index clause, contract length).
- **Generalise.** No logic keyed on case or supplier IDs; runtime knowledge from the data package

"""The case coordinator: one `Negotiator` per case. It prepares the brief (persona, estimate,
floor, anchor, target, levers and claim bank per supplier), keeps the blackboard every thread
reads, and owns the decision to close. The per-thread move is in `thread.py`. Code owns every
number and every binding decision; the model reads the supplier's prose and words our e-mail."""

import json
import logging
import math
import threading
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

from arena_kit.agents import NaiveAgent
from arena_kit.data import DataPackage
from arena_kit.docs import standard_terms
from arena_kit.play import latest, live_threads, moves_left, standing

from . import claims, economics, llm, log, personas, thread

logger = logging.getLogger("buyer")

AGENTS = ("buyer", "naive")
# The case type sets the playbook: these levers come first, the persona's follow.
PLAYBOOK_LEVERS = {
    "quality": ["ppm_commitment", "chargeback_eur_per_complaint"],
    "capacity": ["volume_per_year", "contract_months", "lead_time_days"],
    "renewal": ["index_clause", "contract_months"],
    "raw_material": ["index_clause"],
    "price_increase": ["effective_date"],
    "bundling": ["volume_per_year"],
}


class Negotiator:
    def __init__(self, pkg=None, model=None):
        self.pkg, self.llm = pkg, model
        self.case, self.plan, self.bank = None, {}, None
        self.used_ids = set()  # cited anywhere in the case: each ID counts once per case
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    # ---------- case open ----------

    def prepare(self, case, threads):
        """Before the clock matters: persona, stance, estimate, floor, anchor, target, the lever
        analysis and the claim bank per supplier. With no threads yet (no session) the plan uses the
        current or fallback price in place of the quote, so it can be read before opening a case."""
        self.case, self.plan, self.used_ids = case, {}, set()
        self.bank = claims.ClaimBank(self.pkg, case)
        buyer = case["buyer"]
        trigger, asked = "", None
        if case.get("trigger_doc"):
            asked = (self.bank.fact(case["trigger_doc"]) or {}).get("asked_pct")
            if self.pkg:
                try:
                    trigger = self.pkg.document(case["trigger_doc"])
                except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError, KeyError):
                    trigger = ""
        part = (case.get("parts") or [None])[0]
        alt_terms = (buyer.get("alternative") or {}).get("terms") or {}
        proxy = buyer.get("current_unit_price") or alt_terms.get("unit_price") or buyer.get("fallback_unit_price")
        rivals = len(case.get("suppliers", [])) - 1
        justified = economics.justified_increase_pct(self.bank, part) if case.get("type") == "price_increase" else None

        # Pass 1: what we know about each supplier, and the dossier the model sets the stance from.
        pre = {}
        for sid in case.get("suppliers", []):
            events = threads.get(sid, [])
            opening = latest(events) if events else {}
            name = _signature(opening.get("body", ""))
            persona = personas.build(self.pkg, sid, case) if self.pkg else personas.stranger(sid, case, name)
            if name and persona["name"] == sid:
                persona["name"] = name
            personas.refine(persona, opening.get("body", ""))
            sheet_id, qterms = standing(events) if events else (None, {})
            qprice = qterms.get("unit_price") or proxy
            cost_fact = self.bank.should_cost(part, sid) if part else None
            breakdown = next((b for m in events for b in [thread.breakdown_in(m)] if b), None)
            pre[sid] = {
                "persona": persona,
                "events": events,
                "opening": opening,
                "std": standard_terms(events),
                "sheet_id": sheet_id,
                "qterms": qterms,
                "qprice": qprice,
                "cost_fact": cost_fact and cost_fact[1],
                "breakdown": breakdown,
                "themes": claims.themes_in(trigger + " " + opening.get("body", "")),
            }
            pre[sid]["dossier"] = _dossier(case, pre[sid], trigger, asked, justified, rivals)
        stances = {sid: None for sid in pre}
        if self.llm:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, len(pre))) as pool:
                stances = dict(zip(pre, pool.map(lambda sid: self.llm.stance(pre[sid]["dossier"]), pre), strict=False))

        # Pass 2: the numbers, from the clamped stance.
        for sid, d in pre.items():
            persona, std, qterms, qprice = d["persona"], d["std"], d["qterms"], d["qprice"]
            stance = economics.clamp_stance(stances.get(sid), case, persona)
            est = economics.supplier_estimate(case, persona, std, qprice, d["cost_fact"], stance, d["breakdown"])
            floor = economics.floor_price(case, est, qprice, stance) if qprice else None
            anchor = economics.anchor_price(case, floor, qprice, stance, justified) if qprice else None
            c_open = (
                economics.cost(case, qterms if d["sheet_id"] else {"unit_price": qprice}, std, est)
                if qprice
                else math.inf
            )
            bank_claims = self.bank.for_supplier(sid, persona, threads, d["themes"])
            analysis = []
            if anchor:
                analysis = economics.lever_analysis(
                    case, persona, std, est, anchor, c_open, bank_claims, justified, asked, rivals
                )
            playbook = PLAYBOOK_LEVERS.get(case.get("type"), [])
            if buyer.get("category_goal") == "quality_first":
                playbook = PLAYBOOK_LEVERS["quality"] + playbook
            by_score = [r["lever"] for r in analysis if r["kind"] == "term"]
            negotiable = case.get("negotiable", [])
            levers = list(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    [lv for lv in playbook if lv in by_score]
                    + by_score
                    + [lv for lv in persona["levers"] if lv in negotiable and lv != "unit_price"]
                )
            )
            first = economics.sheets(case, std, est, anchor, levers, floor, standing=qterms or None) if anchor else []
            c_anchor = economics.cost(case, first[0], std, est) if first else c_open
            c_cap = None
            current = buyer.get("current_unit_price")
            if justified is not None and current and first:
                justified_price = round(current * (1 + max(0.0, justified) / 100), 2)
                c_cap = economics.cost(case, {**first[0], "unit_price": justified_price}, std, est)
            target = (
                economics.target_cost(case, c_open, c_anchor, c_cap, stance["capture"])
                if c_open < math.inf
                else math.inf
            )
            self.plan[sid] = {
                "persona": persona,
                "stance": stance,
                "std": std,
                "est": est,
                "quote": qprice,
                "floor": floor,
                "anchor": anchor,
                "justified_pct": justified,
                "asked_pct": asked,
                "c_open": c_open,
                "c_cap": c_cap,
                "target": target,
                "levers": levers,
                "analysis": analysis,
                "themes": d["themes"],
                "dropped": set(),
                "claims": bank_claims,
                "used_ids": set(),
                "rounds": [],
                "hold": {},
                "price_pushes": 0,
                "final_packages": 0,
                "subject": d["opening"].get("subject") or case.get("title", ""),
                "pre_session": not d["events"],
            }
            log.plan(
                {
                    "case": case["case_id"],
                    "supplier": sid,
                    "pre_session": not d["events"],
                    "archetype": persona["archetype"],
                    "tier": persona["importance"]["tier"],
                    "signals": persona["signals"],
                    "stance": stance,
                    "estimate": est,
                    "floor": floor,
                    "anchor": anchor,
                    "quote": qprice,
                    "justified_pct": justified,
                    "asked_pct": asked,
                    "c_open": c_open,
                    "target": target,
                    "levers": levers,
                    "analysis": analysis,
                    "claims": [c["ids"] for c in bank_claims[:6]],
                }
            )
            logger.info(
                "%s %s: %s/%s tier=%s stance=%s floor=%s (%s) anchor=%s quote=%s target=%.0f c_open=%.0f",
                case["case_id"],
                sid,
                persona["archetype"],
                persona["tone"],
                persona["importance"]["tier"],
                stance["source"],
                floor,
                (est or {}).get("source"),
                anchor,
                qprice,
                target,
                c_open,
            )
            for r in analysis:
                logger.info("  lever %s", economics.lever_line(r))

    # ---------- one move in one thread ----------

    def decide_thread(self, case, threads, sid):
        """{"kind": "send", "message": ...} | {"kind": "accept"} | {"kind": "wait"} | {"kind": "drop"}."""
        return thread.decide(self, case, threads, sid)

    # ---------- closing across threads ----------

    def standing_cost(self, case, threads, sid):
        p = self.plan[sid]
        sheet_id, terms = standing(threads[sid])
        std = standard_terms(threads[sid]) or p["std"]
        return economics.cost(case, terms, std, p["est"]) if sheet_id else math.inf

    def best_accept(self, case, threads):
        """The cheapest standing sheet across live threads that passes the gate, as an accept move."""
        best = None
        for sid in live_threads(threads):
            if sid not in self.plan:
                continue
            p = self.plan[sid]
            sheet_id, terms = standing(threads[sid])
            std = standard_terms(threads[sid]) or p["std"]
            if sheet_id and economics.gate_ok(case, terms, std, p["est"]):
                c = economics.cost(case, terms, std, p["est"])
                if best is None or c < best[0]:
                    best = (c, sid, sheet_id)
        if best is None:
            return None
        return {"supplier_id": best[1], "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": best[2]}}}

    def cheaper_thread_moving(self, case, threads, sid):
        """RFQ rule: never accept while a cheaper thread is still open and has moves left."""
        mine = self.standing_cost(case, threads, sid)
        for other in live_threads(threads):
            if other == sid or other not in self.plan:
                continue
            status = latest(threads[other]).get("status")
            if status == "open" and moves_left(case, threads[other]) > 0:
                if self.standing_cost(case, threads, other) < mine:
                    return True
        return False

    def decide(self, case, threads):
        """The kit's one-move interface (`arena_kit.play`): threads take turns, closing goes through best_accept."""
        if self.case is None or self.case.get("case_id") != case.get("case_id"):
            self.prepare(case, threads)
        live = [s for s in live_threads(threads) if not self.plan.get(s, {}).get("stopped")]
        while live:
            sid = min(live, key=lambda s: sum(m.get("from") == "buyer" for m in threads[s]))
            d = self.decide_thread(case, threads, sid)
            if d["kind"] == "send":
                return {"supplier_id": sid, "message": d["message"]}
            if d["kind"] == "accept" and not self.cheaper_thread_moving(case, threads, sid):
                best = self.best_accept(case, threads)
                if best:
                    return best
            self.plan[sid]["stopped"] = True
            live.remove(sid)
        best = self.best_accept(case, threads)
        return best or {"supplier_id": live_threads(threads)[0], "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}

    # ---------- after the case ----------

    def after_case(self, case, threads, result):
        for sid, p in self.plan.items():
            events = threads.get(sid, [])
            checks = {}
            for m in events:
                for c in m.get("claim_results") or []:
                    checks[c.get("result")] = checks.get(c.get("result"), 0) + 1
            log.case(
                {
                    "case": case["case_id"],
                    "supplier": sid,
                    "archetype": p["persona"]["archetype"],
                    "deal": bool(result.get("deal")) and result.get("supplier_id") == sid,
                    "score": result.get("score"),
                    "c_open": result.get("c_open"),
                    "c_deal": result.get("c_deal"),
                    "c_best": result.get("c_best"),
                    "target": p["target"],
                    "rounds": len(p["rounds"]),
                    "statuses": [m.get("status") for m in events if m.get("from") != "buyer"],
                    "claims": checks,
                    "latency_s": [r["latency_s"] for r in p["rounds"]],
                    "replay": result.get("replay_url"),
                }
            )


def _dossier(case, d, trigger, asked, justified, rivals):
    """What the model sets the stance from: the case, our position and the supplier's profile.
    Internal figures stay internal; this text never reaches the supplier."""
    persona, buyer = d["persona"], case["buyer"]
    alt = buyer.get("alternative") or {}
    lines = [
        f"CASE: {case.get('title')} ({case.get('type')}); category goal {buyer.get('category_goal')}; "
        f"{rivals} other bidder(s); need {buyer.get('need_per_year')} a year for {buyer.get('horizon_years')} year(s).",
        f"OUR POSITION: current price {buyer.get('current_unit_price')}; "
        f"fallback price {buyer.get('fallback_unit_price')}; alternative: {alt.get('kind') or 'none'}; "
        f"negotiable: {', '.join(case.get('negotiable', []))}.",
        f"THEIR QUOTE: {d['qprice']} per unit, terms {json.dumps(d['qterms'])}; standard terms {json.dumps(d['std'])}.",
        f"COST DATA: should-cost {d['cost_fact'] and d['cost_fact'].get('unit_cost')}; "
        f"cost breakdown full cost {d['breakdown']}; justified increase {justified}%; asked {asked}%.",
        f"SUPPLIER: {persona['name']} ({persona.get('country') or '?'}, {persona.get('category') or '?'}); "
        f"tier {persona['importance']['tier']} ({persona['importance'].get('reason', '')}); "
        f"archetype {persona['archetype']} / {persona.get('secondary')}; "
        f"profile {json.dumps(persona.get('profile') or {}, default=str)[:1200]}.",
        "SIGNALS: " + "; ".join(persona.get("signals") or []),
        f"THEMES IN ITS LETTER OR QUOTE: {', '.join(d['themes']) or 'none'}.",
        f"ITS OPENING E-MAIL:\n{(d['opening'].get('body') or '')[:1500]}",
    ]
    if trigger:
        lines.append(f"THE LETTER THAT STARTED THE CASE:\n{trigger[:1500]}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _signature(body):
    """The last non-empty line of a supplier's e-mail: usually the company name."""
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in (body or "").splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    return lines[-1][:80] if lines else None


def agent_factory(name, data=None, model=None):
    """A function that returns a fresh agent per case. `data`: the unpacked data package;
    `model`: an `llm.LLM` (default: from .env via `llm.from_env`, None for template moves only)."""
    if name == "naive":
        return NaiveAgent
    package = None
    if data:
        package = DataPackage(data)
        package.lookup("")  # build the ID index once, before parallel agents share it
    if model is None:  # False: no model, template moves only
        model = llm.from_env()
    return lambda: Negotiator(package, model or None)

            sheet_id, terms = standing(threads[sid])
            std = standard_terms(threads[sid]) or p["std"]

    def cheaper_thread_moving(self, case, threads, sid):
        """RFQ rule: never accept while a cheaper thread is still open and has moves left."""
        mine = self.standing_cost(case, threads, sid)
        for other in live_threads(threads):
            if other == sid or other not in self.plan:
                continue

"""The negotiation policy, per supplier thread: plan the non-price terms by C at the supplier's
own valuation, open below its quote, then move toward its counter round by round so it keeps
conceding, with verified claims spread over the rounds. Close on its final offer, its agreement or
the round limit; in relationship goals stop at the price where C is lowest.

What the suppliers showed (sandbox and practice, `docs/learnings.md`):
- they concede only after a move from us and agree as soon as our sheet reaches the counter they
  would make, so our sheet stays below their counter until the end;
- every verified claim they take into account lowers where they stop, most of it in round 1;
- patience runs out at a cumulative gap of about 40 % between our sheets and their counters
  (summed per round, relative to their price), much earlier for a supplier selling near its cost
  or one that is fully booked: a final offer, or a walk-away;
- a large first concession means a deep floor: then we hold low instead of meeting it."""

import threading
import time

from arena_kit.docs import standard_terms
from arena_kit.play import latest, moves_left, standing

from . import llm, writer
from .claims import ClaimBank, rival_offer
from .personas import profile

log = logging.getLogger("buyer")

FRACTION = 0.3  # share of the gap to the supplier's counter we move per round
# Opening price as a share of its quote at our terms, by category goal. Practice C_best sat 12 to
# 22 % below the quote in leverage, routine and secure-supply cases, 1.5 to 3 % in stabilise ones.
ANCHOR = {"leverage": 0.78, "routine": 0.82, "secure_supply": 0.88, "quality_first": 0.88, "stabilise": 0.92}
ANCHOR_MIN = 0.75  # never open lower than this share (an insult costs patience)
BUDGET = 1.0  # patience: the cumulative relative gap we show (no cap for a typical supplier)
DEEP = 0.06  # a first concession this large (share of its quote) means a deep floor
MIN_MOVE = 0.002  # every sheet moves at least this share of the price
FIRST_CLAIMS, LATER_CLAIMS = 3, 1
DONE = {"agreed", "final_offer"}
ENDED = {"walked_away", "no_bid"}
QUESTION = "Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?"

    """One supplier thread: what we know and what we did."""

    def __init__(self, sid):
        self.sid = sid
        self.std = {}
        self.prof = {}
        self.est = {}
        self.terms = {}  # our planned non-price terms (with a price placeholder)
        self.quote = None  # its opening price at our terms
        self.anchor = None
        self.target = None  # relationship goals: the price with the lowest C
        self.budget = BUDGET
        self.claims = []
        self.ours = []  # our prices at s.terms, one per message with a sheet
        self.theirs = []  # its price at our terms, one per reply
        self.gaps = []  # relative gap of each of our sheets to its counter
        self.state = "open"  # open | mirror | closing | done | ended
        self.prev_state = "open"  # the state before the message in flight
        self.pending = None  # the message in flight: what to undo if it times out
        self.tried = set()  # (field, value) we switched away from

class Negotiator:
    def __init__(self, case, pkg=None, complete=None):

        self.bank = ClaimBank(pkg, case)

        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    # -- setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def setup(self, sid, events):
        case, s = self.case, Side(sid)
        s.std = standard_terms(events) or {}
        sheet_id, quote = standing(events)
        s.prof = profile(self.pkg, sid)
        self.sides[sid] = s
        if not sheet_id or quote.get("unit_price") is None:
            s.state = "ended"

        part = (case.get("parts") or [None])[0]

        planned = eco.plan_terms(case, s.std, s.est, quote, q_price * ratio)
        s.terms = planned[0] if planned else eco.at_price(case, quote, q_price * ratio)
        s.anchor = s.terms["unit_price"]
        s.quote = round(eco.price_for_value(case, s.terms, s.est, eco.value(case, quote, s.est)), 2)

        if own:
            return own[0]["unit_cost"], True
        generic = [r for r in rows if not r.get("supplier_id")]
        if generic:
            return generic[0]["unit_cost"], False
        for ref in self.bank.ids("cost:"):  # the case's own facts (no table rows)
            f = self.bank.fact(ref)

        ids = self.bank.ids(f"sc:{sid.split(':')[-1]}@")

    def their_price(self, s, terms):

        same = all(terms.get(k) == v for k, v in s.terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in terms)
        if same:

        v = eco.value(self.case, terms, s.est)
        return round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, s.terms, s.est, v), 2)

    def switch(self, s, new, why):
        """Plan new non-price terms; our last price moves to the same value for the supplier."""
        if s.ours:

            s.ours[-1] = round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, new, s.est, v), 2)
        if s.theirs:
            v = eco.value(self.case, eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.theirs[-1]), s.est)
            s.theirs[-1] = round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, new, s.est, v), 2)

        us what it values. Take a sheet's terms over when C at its price beats C of our plan at
        our counterpart of that price; when it insists on an index clause, take the clause that
        costs us least."""
        if not s.ours:

        clause = standing_terms.get("index_clause")

            # refuses a deadband: we take its clause and keep negotiating the price
            self.switch(s, {**s.terms, "index_clause": clause}, "its index clause")
        best_c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, s.terms, self.their_price(s, standing_terms)), s.std, s.est)
        for sheet in sheets:
            terms = sheet["terms"]
            changed = {k: v for k, v in terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in s.terms and s.terms[k] != v}

            if not changed:
                continue
            new = {**s.terms, **changed}
            if not eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std):
                continue
            if any((k, repr(v)) in s.tried for k, v in changed.items()):

# Understanding anchor and gap

In the local strategy experiments, **anchor** is the discount requested in the
first counteroffer. **Gap** is the remaining price difference the buyer tolerates
before accepting the supplier's standing offer.

These are parameters of the kit's deterministic `NaiveAgent`, not model settings
or discounts selected from supplier research.

## Example: Anchor 20% / gap 1%

1. The supplier asks for EUR 100 per unit.
2. The buyer offers EUR 80: 20% below the supplier's opening price.
3. The supplier counters at EUR 90. The buyer offers EUR 85, halfway between its
   previous EUR 80 offer and the supplier's EUR 90 offer.
4. Negotiation continues. Suppose the buyer's last offer is EUR 88.20 and the
   supplier now asks for EUR 89. The difference is EUR 0.80, below 1% of EUR 89
   (EUR 0.89), so the buyer accepts the supplier's EUR 89 offer.

The normal price rules are:

```text
First counteroffer = supplier opening price * (1 - anchor)
Next counteroffer  = (supplier current price + buyer previous price) / 2
Accept when       = supplier current price - buyer previous price
                    <= supplier current price * gap
```

The gap is measured against the supplier's current price. It is not the final
discount or a target saving. The naive agent can also accept before reaching the
gap when the supplier marks the offer as agreed or final, or no moves remain.

## Reading the experiment labels

| Parameter | Values tested locally | Meaning of a higher value |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor | 3%, 10%, 20% | Request a larger opening discount |
| Gap | 0.5%, 1%, 3% | Tolerate a larger remaining price difference, tending to close earlier |

The three anchors and three gaps produce nine combinations. For example,
`Anchor 10% / gap 0.5%` starts 10% below the opening quote and normally waits
until the difference is at most 0.5% of the supplier's current price.

## What these experiments establish

The local dashboard compares mechanical negotiation rules against a scripted
supplier. The anchor/gap rules do not use company dossiers, correspondence, cost
indices or supplier profiles to choose their parameters or arguments. The
prepared A/B/C research packets have not yet been evaluated with a language model.

A higher simulator score is not a percentage saving or evidence that the same
opening discount will work against hosted supplier bots. The simulator reacts
mainly to price and does not fully represent supplier trade-offs.

The naive acceptance rule does not itself check mandatory conditions or whether
an available alternative is cheaper. The local **Guarded** variant adds those
checks before closing. **Package cost** additionally chooses permitted non-price
terms by total buyer cost. Those experimental variants are distinct from changing
the anchor or gap, and this document does not change the production agent.

Implementation reference: the pinned official kit's
[`NaiveAgent`](https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/blob/1b5516bb95ef28e37f69aa446dc62168864bca53/starter-kit/arena_kit/agents/naive.py).

    def __init__(self, provider=None, model=None, writer_model=None, effort=None):

        """One request; any error is None (the caller has a deterministic fallback)."""
        try:
            if self.provider == "anthropic":
                text = self._anthropic(system, user, timeout, max_tokens, schema, model or self.model)
            else:
                text = self._openai(system, user, timeout, max_tokens, schema, model or self.model)

            output_config=output_config,
            betas=["server-side-fallback-2026-07-01"],

Report on `origin/julian/draft-two`, `origin/joao/explain-anchor-gap` and the PR refs. Nothing was modified or checked out.

**1. draft-two: what it is**

Two commits on top of main: `04ab746` (the policy agent) and `59e3d37` (floor and clamped stance). Diffstat: 16 files, +2956 / -63.

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| `buyer/agent.py` | `Negotiator`: per-case prepare (persona, stance, estimate, floor, anchor, claim bank), shared blackboard, `decide` loop, `best_accept`, `cheaper_thread_moving` (RFQ rule), `_dossier` (text sent to the stance model) |
| `buyer/thread.py` | One move per thread: `read` (model or regex), `reestimate` on breakdown XLSX, `stalled`/`review` closer, `question`, `acknowledge`, `send`, `brief` |
| `buyer/llm.py` | Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible client with JSON schemas. Three calls: `read_reply` (14 s), `stance` (15 s), `write_email` (16 s). Failures return None |
| `buyer/economics.py` | `default_stance`, `clamp_stance` (per-tier ranges), `floor_price` (sustainable margin), `anchor_price`, `best_nonprice` (ties broken by supplier-friendly value), `concession` (falling step share, only after a supplier move), `sheets` (A plus one variant per lever) |
| `buyer/guard.py` | Checks the model e-mail: IDs must match, figures must be in the options, and it falls back to a template |
| `buyer/claims.py`, `personas.py` | Claim bank and persona archetypes, close to the price engine's versions |
| `buyer/log.py`, `runner.py`, `cli.py` | Logging and runner (no campaign or view) |
| `docs/findings.md` | Batch log: 0.96 on D01, 0.54 on D02, with the change behind each step |

**2. Draft-two vs `buyer/policy.py` (price engine)**

| Area | draft-two | price engine |
|---|---|---|
| Reader of supplier reply | Model JSON (`read_reply`), regex fallback | None. Regex in `personas.py` and `signals_in` only |
| Stance | Model proposes opening gap, capture, margin, steps, close step; clamped by code | Constants by tier and goal, no model stance |
| Intent detection | Model fills `interested_in`, `needs_approval`, `cheaper_variant`, `offers_document` | Lever answered is inferred from sheet diffs (`adopt`, `lever_answered`) |
| Floor | `floor_price` = full cost / (1 - sustainable margin), clipped to 75 to 97 % of quote | No floor function. Anchor 0.75 to 0.97 of quote, `ANCHOR_MIN` 0.75 |
| Concession | Falling share of gap (0.35, 0.25, 0.15, 0.10), close step 0.6, only after a move | `FRACTION` 0.3 of gap per round, `MIN_MOVE`, `DEEP` rule |
